answer: An agent economy resists sybils by making each identity carry a real, unrecoverable deposit plus a signed history. A newcomer must post a bond sized to the value it can extract, so spinning up a thousand puppets means locking a thousand deposits. Each identity also keeps a verifiable thread of prior work, and peers sign a cipher-wrapped attestation over it, because forging one is cheaper than earning it, fake agents never accumulate the standing needed to vote or be paid. Bonds priced in sable plus signed history turn mass impersonation into a capital-burning loss.
